query_analysis.original_query: Develop a comprehensive approach to mitigating corrosion risks in high-temperature, high-pressure distillation environments.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a detailed and effective strategy to prevent and mitigate corrosion issues in distillation systems operating under high-temperature and high-pressure conditions, ensuring safe and efficient operation over the long term.
query_analysis.primary_domain: Corrosion Mitigation in High-Temperature Distillation Systems

selected_agents.role: Process design modifications to mitigate corrosion in distillation units
Analyze high-temperature and high-pressure effects on corrosion mechanisms
Safety implications assessment and compliance verification

communication_strategy.information_flow: Integrate findings from all experts to develop a comprehensive corrosion mitigation plan
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative design and safety review cycles with multidisciplinary collaboration

clarification_questions: What materials are currently used in your distillation equipment?
Have specific corrosion mechanisms been identified in your system?
Are there constraints on materials substitution or process modifications?
